L.i.name: L.i
L.i.description: Current flowing from pin p to pin n

emf.phi.name: emf.phi
emf.phi.description: Angle of shaft flange with respect to support (= flange.phi - support.phi)

rotor.w.name: rotor.w
rotor.w.description: Absolute angular velocity of component (= der(phi))

shaft.w.name: shaft.w
shaft.w.description: Absolute angular velocity of component (= der(phi))

load.s.name: load.s
load.s.description: Absolute position of center of component (s = flange_a.s + L/2 = flange_b.s - L/2)

src.v.name: src.v
src.v.description: Voltage drop of the two pins (= p.v - n.v)

L.v.name: L.v
L.v.description: Voltage drop of the two pins (= p.v - n.v)

emf.w.name: emf.w
emf.w.description: Angular velocity of flange relative to support

rotor.a.name: rotor.a
rotor.a.description: Absolute angular acceleration of component (= der(w))

shaft.a.name: shaft.a
shaft.a.description: Absolute angular acceleration of component (= der(w))

emf.v.name: emf.v
emf.v.description: Voltage drop between the two pins

mount.lossPower.name: mount.lossPower
mount.lossPower.description: Loss power leaving component via heatPort (> 0, if heat is flowing out of component)

src.i.name: src.i
src.i.description: Current flowing from pin p to pin n

R.i.name: R.i
R.i.description: Current flowing from pin p to pin n

R.v.name: R.v
R.v.description: Voltage drop of the two pins (= p.v - n.v)

R.LossPower.name: R.LossPower
R.LossPower.description: Loss power leaving component via heatPort

emf.i.name: emf.i
emf.i.description: Current flowing from positive to negative pin

emf.internalSupport.tau.name: emf.internalSupport.tau
emf.internalSupport.tau.description: External support torque (must be computed via torque balance in model where InternalSupport is used; = flange.tau)

gear.phi_a.name: gear.phi_a
gear.phi_a.description: Angle between left shaft flange and support

gear.phi_b.name: gear.phi_b
gear.phi_b.description: Angle between right shaft flange and support

r2t.internalSupportR.tau.name: r2t.internalSupportR.tau
r2t.internalSupportR.tau.description: External support torque (must be computed via torque balance in model where InternalSupport is used; = flange.tau)

r2t.internalSupportT.f.name: r2t.internalSupportT.f
r2t.internalSupportT.f.description: External support force (must be computed via force balance in model where InternalSupport is used; = flange.f)

R.alpha.name: R.alpha
R.alpha.description: Temperature coefficient of resistance (R_actual = R*(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))

emf.useSupport.name: emf.useSupport
emf.useSupport.description: = true, if support flange enabled, otherwise implicitly grounded

gear.useSupport.name: gear.useSupport
gear.useSupport.description: = true, if support flange enabled, otherwise implicitly grounded

r2t.useSupportR.name: r2t.useSupportR
r2t.useSupportR.description: = true, if rotational support flange enabled, otherwise implicitly grounded

r2t.useSupportT.name: r2t.useSupportT
r2t.useSupportT.description: = true, if translational support flange enabled, otherwise implicitly grounded

load.L.name: load.L
load.L.description: Length of component, from left flange to right flange (= flange_b.s - flange_a.s)

mount.s_nominal.name: mount.s_nominal
mount.s_nominal.description: Nominal value of s_rel (used for scaling)

R.T.name: R.T
R.T.description: Fixed device temperature if useHeatPort = false

f_x.origin: flow sum equation: emf.n.i + src.n.i + gnd.p.i = 0
